About.title: Stories, games and the curiosity to understand things.

paragraphs.writing: I enjoy writing because it is where loose ideas find rhythm. Sometimes it becomes a story; other times, simply a better way to understand what I am thinking.
paragraphs.games: Games have always been part of my life. I enjoy their worlds, choices and the details that make time disappear for a few hours.
paragraphs.making: I also enjoy hardware, assembling, taking things apart and finding out why something works. Curiosity often begins with one extra screw left on the table.
paragraphs.people: I value honest conversations, humor, curious people and the freedom to learn without pretending I already know everything.
